missionPremise: Supervisor hole: 00 sets default_transaction_read_only = on, then 01 CREATE TEMP TABLE. Postgres and Neon replicas refuse that, so the session is not planner-runnable on a short-lived RO URI. Source: _inbox/2026-08-30_p2-juris_supervisor_review.md hole 1; dispatch 2026-08-30_p2-juris-session.
chosenFix: CTE rewrite (option 1), not the RO-prove-and-keep-temps option. Temps on a second connection would still not make 01 runnable on the RO URI the card asks for.

design.01: One WITH MATERIALIZED pipeline (cities, parcels_six, parcel_hits, parcel_jurisdiction, parcel_slivers). No DROP/CREATE TEMP/CREATE INDEX. Reports TOTALS (native columns) plus BY_COUNTY / METHOD / SLIVERS / DENOM_CHECK / CDP_ASSERT / CITY_TABLE_CDP / KYLE_IN / RURAL_BASTROP / UNRESOLVED_AFTER as jsonb on the same row so the 981k join runs once.
design.00: Keeps SET default_transaction_read_only = on and statement_timeout 180s. Adds empty-city RAISE (fail closed). Adds a durable CREATE TABLE probe that must refuse; proving RO with CREATE TEMP TABLE is the hole and is not used.
design.02: City-county probes only (Coupland, straddles). Own cities/counties CTEs. Parcel probes live on the 01 row.
design.03: City-county overlap as CTEs. Roster is VALUES, not TEMP+INSERT. PERSIST_SPEC stays SELECT. UPDATE stays commented.
design.04: Seed-only CDP/unknown reports as VALUES CTE. Parcel-matched ALIAS_DISAGREE is not re-run (would be a second 180s join). leave_behind.
design.05: EXPLAIN of the same cities JOIN parcels CTE. No LATERAL. No temp names.
keep: zone-major FROM cities JOIN parcels on btree bbox then ST_Intersects
floor 1e-8 deg2 on ring hits only
no CDP place_fips; unincorporated is the disposition
03 PERSIST_SPEC leave_behind; do not execute persist
design.tieBreak: DISTINCT ON (county_fips, prop_id) ORDER BY feature_index NULLS LAST, then west/south/east/north. Named so a null or tied feature_index is not an arbitrary winner.

adversarial.risk: Doing both options half-way: CTE rewrite plus temps on a second connection
adversarial.response: Option 1 only. No CREATE TEMP in 00-05. Durable CREATE TABLE in 00 is the RO refuse probe, not a temp path.

adversarial.risk: Repeating the 981k join per report, or losing native TOTALS columns
adversarial.response: One WITH. TOTALS stay native columns on the single result row. Other reports are jsonb on that row.

adversarial.risk: Empty tx_city_boundary emits 981k unincorporated and a green-looking TOTALS miss that is really a missing table
adversarial.response: 00 and 01 RAISE before the join. totals also CASE-guards on zero usable city geoms (1/0).

adversarial.risk: LATERAL sneaks back as a decode convenience
adversarial.response: Decode stays WITH decoded. Guard script fails on LATERAL in executable 01/05.
